title: Your Next Adventure in WoW: Forever Starts in the WoW Portal Room
author: Blizzard Entertainment

short_news.title_en: Your Next Adventure in WoW: Forever Starts in the WoW Portal Room

path: A Gathering Place for Every Kind of WoW Player
changes.text: The WoW Portal Room is the official World of Warcraft Discord server, bringing players and community Ambassadors together in an inclusive hub. Whether you’re learning the ropes, returning to the game, sharing years of knowledge, or looking for a new group for your next chapter, the Portal Room can point you in the right direction. Like any portal, it is a gateway—not the final destination.
